title: Rebirth: the peoples you can be reborn as, your soul's span, and how fate knots and returns work (ADR-0030)

peoples.description: Who you can be, drawn once per world by weight (a Truth). Mods add peoples by species id; a weight of 0 takes one out of the roll.

openingKey.description: The opening card's words for waking as this people

soulSpanYears.description: [min, max] years your soul lasts from arrival, whatever the body

triggers.description: Event keys after which the director ties a knot (a turn in the story)

quietAfterHours.description: At dawn, a knot is tied if none has been for this many hours

safeHealthAtLeast.description: No knot while your health is below this

recentDays.description: Knots from this many days before a death are recent; the rest are old

tailPermille.description: The chance a return reaches into the deep past (an old knot)

minHoursBeforeDeath.description: A knot must be at least this long before the death to be picked

strengthPct.description: A remembered feeling carries this share of what you felt in the lost future

minFeeling.description: Without a grudge or a friend's death, a feeling is remembered only if the lost future moved your regard by at least this much
